title: The Shiʿi esotericist
summary: Melvin-Koushki reports no biography from Corbin, only the assertion that Ibn Turka is an openly Shiʿi thinker, built on Corbin's study of the R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat, which puts the Imams and their heirs at the summit of knowledge. The phases below are the periodisation this reading needs, using the life claims' dates; they are not Corbin's own. Completed by Ṭihrānī and Jūdī-Niʿmatī, the Sunni face of the apologies is taqiyya or a crypto-Shiʿi's cover.
